scope: v33 development: one-piece PETG front head/muzzle, internal nose service opening, ReSpeaker Lite v1.1 STEP on two integral supports with M2x12/nuts. Head axes, inherited head interferences, cables/acoustics and variant confirmation remain open.

fasteners.supplier_candidate: Botland NSZ-00637; nominal head/nut envelopes, not measured hardware
fasteners.scope: v29 tail + v30 IMU + v31 main regulator + v32 ToF; not whole robot BOM + v33 microphones

imu_mount.note: Board frame, not validated sensor-chip output orientation. Cable envelopes are reserved space, not a measured connector/complete harness. Fit nuts with deck removed.

power_mount.note: Main regulator only. AUX unchanged. Bought PCB mass 4.8 g; terminals 2 g each assumed. Wire envelopes local and not routed. Top screwdriver route may require removing overhead distribution module.

tof_mount.optical_proof: Conservative full package-top rectangle plus about 0.3 mm, expanded at 22.5 degree half-angle to local z=60; no protective glass, no optical certification
tof_mount.harness: Direct soldered wires with local keepout only, no header or full routed cable
tof_mount.inherited_head_interferences: Must be reported separately from new mounting collisions; do not infer full head clearance

microphone_mount.unverified: Physical board revision differs from wiki dimensions; no plugged USB/XIAO, cable routing, acoustic port or clamp torque approval
microphone_mount.screw_direction: Upwards; head under PETG at Z132, nut above PCB at Z141.11
microphone_mount.assembly_sequence: Fit microphones before EarL. Left top-wrench corridor requires EarL absent; final detachable ear mounting unresolved.

nose_service.service: Access with front head removed; not an assembled-cat service guarantee
nose_service.operation_order: Pocket in recovered head shell BEFORE union with muzzle; not a pocket through the entire fused face

head_topology_recovery.method: OCCT8 MakerVolume main cell, native pocket before muzzle union; manifold mesh verified separately
head_topology_recovery.bop_warnings: BOP errors including SelfIntersect/TooSmallEdge/C0/curve-on-surface remain OPEN; mesh and operation checks are not a manufacturing release
